verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud workspaces keep running after you close your laptop. Workspaces and chats are shared, so they can be opened by link and picked up where you left off. Cloud workspaces can also be driven through the API or the hosted MCP server from other clients such as ChatGPT or Claude. That implies cross-machine continuation, but it is framed around teammates and a Mac app rather than one user switching devices. missing for 10: explicit docs on one user resuming a session on another device, a browser or web client for continuing work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
